summary.goal: Validate task contracts on steps at plan creation time

acceptance_criteria.description: TaskContract schema: { inputs: ContractInput[], outputs: ContractOutput[], done_definition: DoneDefinition }
ContractInput: { name, type: artifact|context|parameter, source: step_id|plan, required, description? }
ContractOutput: { name, type: file|directory|schema|config, path?, validation: exists|schema|test|human, schema_ref? }
validateContract(step, plan) checks: input sources exist, output types valid
Contract is optional - plans without contracts still valid
